Results
✓ PASS permission check served from cache p50 · p99
$user->can('posts.edit') resolved in 0.21 ms (p50), 0.48 ms (p99) — 70× faster than the database guard.
Why:
Roles and permissions are denormalized into Redis on every write, so a gate check becomes a single O(1) lookup instead of N joins per request — latency stays flat as your permission matrix grows.
